assertions: The verifier requires the exact addon filename derived from the locked platform package version rather than accepting an arbitrary versioned native file.
The packaged sharp core and native package metadata versions must match package-lock.json.
Platforms whose native package declares a sharp-libvips dependency must preserve the exact locked dependency version and the package-declared loader and binary exports.

Windows is handled separately because libvips ships inside the native package; locked Sharp 0.35.4 requires libvips-42.dll and libvips-cpp-8.18.6.dll, and unknown Sharp versions fail closed pending layout review.
Both Windows DLL omissions and macOS addon, loader, and libvips binary omissions are exercised through the production verifier seam.

resolvedFinding.finding: The first reviewed revision allowed a Windows bundle with the exact addon but without either embedded libvips DLL to pass.
resolvedFinding.resolution: The final verifier maps the reviewed locked Windows Sharp version to its embedded libvips ABI version and requires both DLLs; focused negative cases cover each omission.

limits: This review verifies package inventory logic and fixtures; it does not claim an actual Windows packaged runtime launch.
The assertion is invalid if either scoped file hash changes.
